text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — need to lock the webinar format. Proposal: 45 min talk + 3x10min micro-breakouts where attendees pick a lab (cost ops, latency tuning, evals). Thoughts?
Priya (Host): I like the micro-labs. Helps with lead gen segmentation. Can we confirm speakers for each lab first?
Alex (Growth): +1. Labs give us better follow-up hooks (checklist + template). We should also push one interactive benchmark walkthrough.
Jordan (Product): Product can run the latency tuning lab — Leo can demo autoscaling + batching tips.
Leo (Eng): Happy to. I'll prep a short script and one live console demo. Need a backup plan if GPU pool flaps.
Samira (Speaker Ops): Speakers: Jordan (latency), TBA for cost ops, Priya or Maya to moderate Q&A. @Ben can we reserve a dedicated nodal pool for the demo rehearsal?
Ben (Ops): I can spin a small dedicated pool for rehearsal windows. When are rehearsals? I propose two rehearsals: dry-run (tech check) 2 days before, full run-through 1 day before.
Maya (Marketing): Schedule looks good. Draft run-of-show v0 (10:30 PT):
```
10:30 - Welcome + agenda (Priya) - 5m
10:35 - Keynote: Production inference tradeoffs - 25m (Maya + Jordan)
11:00 - Micro-lab intros - 5m
11:05 - Breakout labs (3 concurrent 10m sessions) - 10m
11:15 - Regroup + live Q&A - 15m
11:30 - CTA + follow-up resources - 5m
```
Priya (Host): Can we shorten keynote to 20m so labs get 15m? attendees need time to act.
Alex (Growth): Favor shorter keynote. Also want a quick poll during keynote to route attendees into labs. Use the poll to tag leads in HubSpot.
Samira (Speaker Ops): I'll own speaker briefs and the poll copy. Need speaker slides by EOD Thu.
Leo (Eng): For the demo backup: I'll prepare a canned gif/recording if the live pool is unavailable.
Ben (Ops): Reserve rehearsal pool now. Tagging DeployBot to create rehearsal env.
DeployBot: rehearsal-env created: rwdw-demo-rehearsal-175001. Scheduled maintenance window cleared.
Maya (Marketing): Promo copy draft: "Practical inference: lower cost, lower latency — live micro-labs for engineers." Will share draft for edits.
Alex (Growth): Add line about follow-up lab templates + benchmark script download. Drive MQLs.
Priya (Host): Confirmed moderation plan: I'll collect top 3 questions during labs and seed them into the final Q&A.
Samira (Speaker Ops): Reminder: speakers, submit 2 backup lines for segues (if panel vs solo).
Maya (Marketing): OK — action items: 1) Samira gets slides and speaker bios by EOD Thu; 2) Leo preps live + recorded demo; 3) Ben confirms rehearsal env (done); 4) Alex preps poll + follow-up assets; 5) Priya finalizes host script. Rehearsals: dry-run = 1750180000, full run = 1750266400.
Jordan (Product): Thanks — will upload slide deck to the greenroom folder when ready.
Priya (Host): Cool. If nobody objects, I'll update calendar invites and landing page sections this afternoon. :thumbsup:
Maya (Marketing): No objections. Locking format. Good work team — this should be a tight, engineer-friendly session. :rocket:
